label: Illustrative, authored from public trial information
short_title: Fianlimab + cemiplimab + chemotherapy vs placebo + cemiplimab + chemotherapy, first-line advanced NSCLC
why_chosen: Regeneron's first-line NSCLC trial and the reference case for this demo. The registry gives every drug as IV every 3 weeks, so a 21-day cycle is public information.
dosing: All study drugs IV every 3 weeks (registry: "Administered intravenously (IV) every 3 weeks (Q3W)")
registry_notes: Registry detailed description: "Phase 3 was not initiated". The schedule below describes the Phase 2 design.

assumptions: The registry does not publish a schedule of assessments. Visit windows, lab panels and imaging cadence are authored from standard NSCLC practice and common first-line industry protocol design, not copied from the protocol.

Priced reference regimen: carboplatin or cisplatin + pemetrexed for 4 cycles, then pemetrexed maintenance (non-squamous). Squamous participants receive paclitaxel; its 3-hour infusion would add two extra-hour infusion lines per induction cycle and is not modelled.
Study drugs supplied by the sponsor are never billed; only their administration appears.
Tumor assessments every 6 weeks to week 48, then every 9 weeks (common first-line design; the registry is silent on cadence).
